verdict.rationale: Pylon's architecture keeps agent and human work on the same issue thread — the issue log shows all steps/outcomes the AI took (pylon-docs-19), agents can be assigned issues for humans to review (pylon-docs-18, pylon-docs-40), and Pylon uses AI to summarize conversations (pylon-docs-33, pylon-docs-53) — implying context continuity when a human takes over. However, there is no explicit documentation of an 'escalation' event, a dedicated summary artifact handed to the agent, or an assurance the customer doesn't repeat themselves. Missing for 10: explicit escalation-trigger documentation, a named summary/handoff object, and any hands-on or customer evidence confirming seamless human takeover.
